name: rhythm-rush
description: Rhythm Rush: ESP32 musical button game with an Express + SQLite backend, ML models and a React kiosk website.

scripts.install-all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test-all: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix frontend run lint && python ml/game_rules.py && python ml/check_exports.py
scripts.retrain: python ml/train_skill.py && python ml/train_animal.py && python ml/train_difficulty.py && python ml/check_exports.py
